parts.title: Secret Entrance
parts.summary: A circular safe dial numbered 0 through 99 starts at 50. Apply an ordered sequence of left (L) and right (R) click rotations modulo 100 and count how many rotations leave the dial resting on 0.

proposals.name: Direct Euclidean Modular Simulation
proposals.summary: Parse lines into immutable Rotation value objects and fold linearly from 50 using Euclidean modulo, preserving full rotation distances for tracing and Part 2 reuse.
proposals.complexity: O(N) time, O(N) parsed / O(1) solver working space
proposals.tradeoffs: Immune to JS negative-remainder and safe-integer overflow bugs; preserves raw multi-turn distances.

proposals.name: Unwrapped Prefix-Sum Congruence Counting
proposals.summary: Accumulate unwrapped signed deltas on the integer line and count prefix sums divisible by 100.
proposals.complexity: O(N) time, O(N) parsed / O(1) auxiliary space
proposals.tradeoffs: Concise math, but risks safe-integer overflow on huge synthetic inputs and still requires modulo reduction for dial rendering.

proposals.name: Zero-Allocation Streaming Digit-Modulo Fold
proposals.summary: Fold raw characters directly modulo 100 without allocating rotation objects.
proposals.tradeoffs: Fastest memory profile, but discards full revolution distances needed for rich visualization and potential Part 2 reuse.

parts.selectionRationale: Runs in O(N) time and O(1) solver space with zero overflow risk, while preserving full rotation distances in 2025/day01/shared/ for visualization and Part 2 reuse.
parts.inFlightWork: Implementing shared/core/math, 2025/day01/shared/rotation, Part 1 domain solver, 100% coverage TDD tests, and SVG safe-dial visualization via Flash.
